summary: 3M Company filed a Form 8-K on September 10, 2026, reporting the closing of a €1.5 billion senior notes offering under its existing Form S-3 shelf registration. The offering consisted of €500 million 3.500% notes due 2028, €500 million 3.900% notes due 2031, and €500 million 4.100% notes due 2034, priced on September 3, 2026, with Deutsche Bank, BofA, Citi and J.P. Morgan as underwriter representatives. Net proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, potentially including debt repayment or refinancing. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation; watch future use-of-proceeds disclosure and any concurrent liability management actions.
